news.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
news.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to “offshore, and often unregulated, venues.”

news.title: CFTC gets into legal clash over stock perps after having cleared path for crypto version
news.summary: A group backed by Citadel Securities and other firms sued the U.S. derivatives regulator for opening a path for perps that it argued belong in the SEC's hands.
